source.gives: Coalbrookdale furnace in blast 10 Jan 1709 (Darby I, ex Bristol copper smelting where coke was used); Grace's says 'first coke furnace' is not strictly correct but first in Europe to last; Smiles says charcoal at first, coke introduced gradually (sources disagree); Darby II expanded coke use from 1730
